access_governance.admin_boundary: infra/ is the restricted root repository for GitHub and access governance, cloned by lazurio update only for Admins of the Organization.
access_governance.agent_rule: An agent may propose an access change; approval belongs to the Admins of the Organization with access to infra.

agent_processes.agent_rule: Write a repeatable procedure as a skill. Documentation explains why, a skill says how.
agent_processes.runtime_rule: Use Bun as the runtime. Do not add a new npm- or Node-only process without a colleague's decision.

customer_segments.description: The company has no single fixed segment; every experiment defines its own customer, channel and offer in its spec. A segment without an experiment is only a hypothesis.

decision_rules.rule: A person confirms financial steps, externally visible actions and anything with legal or platform impact in advance. An agent never starts an automation that generates spam, fake engagement or misleading claims.
decision_rules.trigger: money movement, external visibility, platform ToS, legal or reputational risk

decision_rules.rule: Only a mechanism with a verified signal from an experiment may be scaled; the stop or scale decision is recorded in workspace/experiments.

metrics.description: Number of mechanisms with a verified income signal recorded in playbooks.
Number of finished experiments with an explicit stop or scale decision and recorded evidence.
Net income of running mechanisms after costs, per workspace/finance.

revenue_drivers.description: Income from online mechanisms that passed an experiment with a verified signal. Only what has evidence is scaled; a hypothesis stays in research or experiments.
Repeatable playbooks of verified mechanisms: a documented procedure, unit economics and guardrails, ready to be run again or transferred.

risks.description: An experiment slides into spam, fake engagement, terms-of-service evasion or misleading claims.
risks.escalation: Stop immediately, record it in the experiment log and escalate to the Founder.

risks.description: A mechanism starts to be scaled or presented as working without evidence from an experiment.
risks.escalation: Return it to workspace/experiments and add a measurable test with a stop condition.

risks.description: Work copies another company's brand, content, data or account setup instead of legally adapting the mechanism.
risks.escalation: Stop the implementation, remove the copied material and rewrite it as the company's own adaptation.

risks.description: Sensitive payment or financial data reaches Git without anonymisation.
risks.escalation: Do not commit; anonymise the data or keep it outside Git, and ask an Admin of the Organization for a review.

value_propositions.description: Legal adaptations of demonstrably working online mechanisms: own brand, own data, own offer and no evasion of platform rules.

colleague_overlays.agent_rule: Never read or copy another person's private or archive folder. Treat these paths as local only. The folders samtaylor/ and robinlee/ are onboarding scaffolds without a confirmed role; an agent does not infer their responsibilities.
colleague_overlays.folder_name_rule: Each colleague's folder matches the local OS user name: the OS user alexmorgan has company/colleagues/alexmorgan.

application_versions.purpose: Second generation based on v1 learnings.

data_versions.source_of_truth: First production or prototype data namespace.
Next generation namespace after migration and parity checks.

migration_rules.rule: A generation migration must define old source of truth, new source of truth, transform, parity check, cutover and rollback or archive readability.

generation_policy.prototype_rule: The best implementation plan is a prototype. v1 learns, v2 uses v1 as input, v3 uses v2 as input.

glossary_contract.agent_rule: If a business, data or workflow term is missing or ambiguous, the agent must not guess. It must ask or propose a definition.

decision_rights.rule: The Founder decides what is a legal adaptation and what is a grey zone; an agent never bypasses a guardrail and escalates a borderline case.
Access to sensitive financial data and payment provider exports is approved by an Admin of the Organization through infra/access.
Changes that affect how others can fork and reuse this reference Organization need a readable diff and a review.

knowledge_surfaces.agent_policy: Agents may proactively write internal drafts and public candidates. Public publishing requires owner review and evidence-backed claims.

modules.notes: Agent workflows, integrations and runtime. An automation is connected only after a manual check that it creates no spam, no terms-of-service evasion and no security risk.
Public publishing and acquisition assets. No third-party content, fake engagement or claims without evidence.
Experiment specs, run logs, metrics, results, stop or scale decisions and the guardrail audit.
Costs, revenue, unit economics, payment provider exports and the experiment audit. Sensitive data stays out of Git unless it is safely anonymized.
Strategy, decision logic, guardrails and lessons learned. Document-native knowledge with a read-only viewer App.
Verified, repeatable mechanisms. Hypotheses do not belong here; they stay in research and experiments.
Mechanism scans, source notes, market maps and the evidence for deciding what to test.

roles.purpose: Decides what is worth time, money and reputational risk; holds the guardrails, the stop or scale decisions and the direction of the company.
Maps online mechanisms and assembles the evidence for what is worth testing; keeps mechanism, evidence and risk apart.
Designs and runs small measurable experiments with a budget and a stop condition; records results and evidence.

source_of_truth_matrix.write_rule: Changes to the structure of the Organization are written to lazurio.organization.json and validated before the commit. company.gen3.json is a generated compatibility projection for older readers: never edited by hand, changed only with lazurio migrate organization-manifest <task-worktree> --write.

The module inventory and the Team membership of modules are written to the root modules.manifest.json. company.gen3.json#modules is only generated from it by the same lazurio migrate organization-manifest <task-worktree> --write.
Strategy, decision logic, guardrails and lessons learned change in the knowledgebase. Downstream surfaces are derived from it.
Mechanism scans, source notes and market maps belong in research. Every claim has a source and a date of verification.
Experiment specs, run logs, metrics and stop or scale decisions live in experiments. Without a recorded experiment there is no evidence.
Only a mechanism with a verified signal from an experiment is promoted to playbooks. Hypotheses stay in research or experiments.
Public publishing and acquisition assets. No third-party content, fake social proof or claims without evidence.
Agent workflows and runtime are connected only after the mechanism and its guardrails are verified by hand; an automation never generates spam or evades terms of service.
Unit economics, costs and revenue of experiments. Sensitive data enters Git only safely anonymised; the rest stays outside Git.
Live work is never written in Markdown; an agent records it in TODO.tasks.json.
Open questions are resolved by a colleague with an agent and become tasks once decided.

teams.description: Default Team of Lazurio Example Organization. The Organization has a single Team, and it covers every workspace module.

workspaces.description: Default Team of Lazurio Example Organization. The Organization has a single Team, and it covers every workspace module.
